answers.core:
Having Vector4 in core would allow engine functions to use it as a built-in type whenever it's necessary to work with four numbers. An analysis of how many engine functions could benefit from this would be a good idea first. Again, this proposal is mostly for discussion.

It might indeed be a better idea for this to be an add-on, but [this isn't possible in GDScript](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/279).
answers.workaround: Yes-ish. I have a C# implementation [here](https://github.com/aaronfranke/GodotExtraMath/blob/master/ExtraMath/Vector4.cs). It's not really feasible to make within GDScript, but the real solution there would be to allow custom structs in GDScript: #279
